hba_software_initialization_sequence: 1. (BIOS or OS) Enable HBA in PCI cfg: set CMD.MSE=1 (Memory Space Enable) and CMD.BME=1 (Bus Master Enable).
2. Read ABAR (PCI cfg offset 24h) to learn AHCI register base.
3. Read GHC; if CAP.SAM=0, set GHC.AE=1.
4. (Optional) Set GHC.HR=1 to perform a full HBA reset; poll GHC.HR until self-cleared to 0; redo step 3.
5. Read CAP — derive supported features: NP (port count), NCS (slot count), ISS (max speed), S64A, SNCQ, SSS, SAL, EMS, FBSS, CCCS, SAM, SPM, PMD.
6. Read CAP2 — derive SDS, SADM, DESO, APST, BOH.
7. (Optional BIOS/OS handoff) If CAP2.BOH=1: OS sets BOHC.OOS=1; polls BOHC.BOS until BIOS clears it to 0; clears BOHC.OOC if set.
8. Read PI; for each port bit set, proceed to per-port initialization.
per_port_initialization_sequence: 1. Read PxCMD — if ST=1, clear ST=0 and wait for CR=0; if FRE=1, clear FRE=0 and wait for FR=0; if CLO is needed, set CLO=1 (CAP.SCLO=1) and wait CLO=0.
2. Allocate Command List in system memory (1 KB aligned, 1024 B for NCS+1 ≤ 32 Command Headers); program PxCLB[31:10] and PxCLBU (if S64A=1).
3. Allocate Received FIS Structure (256 B aligned, 256 B; or 4 KB aligned + 4 KB if FBS); program PxFB[31:8] and PxFBU (if S64A=1).
6. Clear IS bit for this port (write 1).
7. If CAP.SSS=1 (Staggered Spin-up): set PxCMD.SUD=1 to release the device from cold-power-down; otherwise SUD is RO 1.
8. (Optional) Configure PxSCTL.SPD to limit max speed; PxSCTL.IPM to allow / disallow Partial / Slumber.
9. Set PxCMD.FRE=1 to enable FIS reception.
10. Wait for PxSSTS.DET=03 (device + Phy) and PxTFD.STS.BSY=0 (device ready); read PxSIG to learn device type.
11. Configure PxIE per-bit interrupt mask for this port.
12. Set PxCMD.ST=1 to start the port DMA engine.
single_non_ncq_dma_read_sequence: 1. Software finds a free Command List slot (PxCI bit = 0).

2. Allocate Command Table in system memory (128-byte aligned); fill CFIS (H2D Register FIS, FIS Type 0x27, command = e.g. READ DMA EXT 0x25, LBA, count); fill PRDT with scatter/gather DBA / DBC entries.

3. Populate Command Header at PxCLB + slot×32: CFL = CFIS length in Dwords, W=0 (read), A=0, C=1 (clear BSY on R_OK), PMP=0, PRDTL = number of PRD entries; CTBA / CTBAU = Command Table physical address.
5. HBA fetches Command Header → Command Table → transmits CFIS to device; sets PxTFD.STS.BSY=1.
6. Device returns R_OK; HBA clears PxTFD.STS.BSY (C=1).
7. Device sends DMA Setup FIS; HBA copies to DSFIS.
8. Device sends Data FIS(es); HBA streams payload into PRDT-described buffer(s); updates PRDBC.
9. Device sends D2H Register FIS with I=1; HBA copies to RFIS, updates PxTFD, sets PxIS.DHRS, clears PxCI[slot].
10. Software reads IS, then PxIS, then PxCI to identify completed slot; reads RFIS for completion status.
single_non_ncq_dma_write_sequence: 1. Same as read sequence steps 1-3 but Command Header W=1 (write).
3. HBA transmits CFIS; device returns R_OK.
4. Device sends DMA Activate FIS (or HBA pre-activates for NCQ); HBA streams Data FIS from PRDT-described system memory to device.
5. Device sends D2H Register FIS with I=1; HBA finalizes.
ncq_command_sequence: 1. Software allocates Command Slot[tag]; builds CFIS with NCQ command READ FPDMA QUEUED (0x60) or WRITE FPDMA QUEUED (0x61) and NCQ Tag = slot index.
3. HBA transmits CFIS; PxCI[slot] clears when CFIS completes (R_OK + C=1).
4. Device may interleave DMA Setup FISes with NCQ Tag identifying which queued command's data is flowing.
5. Device sends Set Device Bits FIS with the SActive field's bit set for each completed slot; HBA clears those PxSACT bits, sets PxIS.SDBS.
6. Multiple NCQ commands may be outstanding simultaneously (up to 32 = CAP.NCS+1).
port_reset_sequence: 4. HBA + PHY perform COMRESET → COMINIT → COMWAKE → ALIGN-lock → Speed Negotiation → L0.
5. PxSSTS.DET transitions 00→01→03; PxSSTS.SPD reflects negotiated speed.
6. Device sends initial D2H Register FIS with its signature; HBA updates PxSIG and PxTFD.
7. PxTFD.STS.BSY = 0 indicates device is ready for commands.
software_reset_sequence_srst: 1. Software clears PxCI to 0; waits PxTFD.STS.BSY=0 or uses CLO if stuck.
2. Build a Command Header with R=1 + W=0 + C=0 (do not clear BSY) + CFL=5; allocate Command Table; build CFIS = H2D Register FIS with Device Control SRST bit = 1, C bit = 0.
3. Set PxCI[slot]=1; wait until HBA transmits the FIS (no completion expected for this half).
4. Wait at least 5 µs; build a second Command Header (next slot) with R=1 + CFL=5; CFIS = H2D Register FIS with SRST bit = 0.
5. Set PxCI[next slot]=1; wait for PxTFD.STS.BSY=0.
6. Read PxSIG to confirm device reset; read RFIS for the post-reset D2H Register FIS.
hba_reset_sequence: 2. HBA resets all state machines + IS + per-port state to reset values; PxSCTL is preserved; PI is HwInit-loaded; BOHC unaffected.
3. GHC.HR self-clears to 0 when reset complete.
4. If CAP.SSS=1 (staggered spin-up), software is responsible for spinning up each port via PxCMD.SUD=1 after the reset.
hot_plug_sequence: 2. PxSSTS.DET transitions; PxSERR.DIAG.X set; PxIS.PCS set (if PCE in PxIE).
3. Software acknowledges PxIS.PCS (write 1), then clears PxSERR.DIAG.X (write 1 to bit 26).
4. If new device present, re-run per-port initialization (steps 1-12 above).
power_state_transition_sequence_partial_: 1. Software ensures PxCI=0 + PxSACT=0 (no outstanding commands).
3. HBA sends PMREQ_P (Partial) or PMREQ_S (Slumber) primitive; device responds PMACK or PMNAK.
4. On PMACK, both PHYs enter the requested state; PxSSTS.IPM updates to 2h or 6h; PxCMD.ICC reads back as 0h Idle.
5. Exit: software writes PxCMD.ICC=1h (Active); HBA wakes the PHY; PxSSTS.IPM returns to 1h.
devsleep_sequence_ahci_1_3_1: 1. Verify CAP2.SDS=1 and PxDEVSLP.DSP=1 (device + platform support DEVSLP).
2. Ensure port is idle (PxCI=0 and PxSACT=0).
3. Ensure interface is in Slumber if CAP2.DESO=1; otherwise any state OK.
5. HBA asserts DEVSLP sideband HIGH; PxSSTS.IPM transitions to 8h after at least PxDEVSLP.MDAT ms of assertion.
6. Exit: software writes PxCMD.ICC=1h (Active); HBA de-asserts DEVSLP; device becomes ready within PxDEVSLP.DETO ms; if PHY re-init needed, OOB sequence runs.
ncq_unload_sequence: 1. (Emergency only) Software issues NCQ Unload — non-queued command intended to park the disk head.
2. NCQ Unload may be mixed with queued commands; it is the only non-queued command allowed during NCQ.
3. HBA transmits the unload CFIS; verifies BSY/DRQ/ERR clear before resuming NCQ command list walk.
bios_os_handoff_sequence_BOH: 1. OS reads BOHC: if BOS=1 (BIOS owns), OS sets OOS=1; clears OOC if it was 1.
2. BIOS sees OOS=1, sets BB=1 (BIOS Busy) while it finishes cleanup, then clears BOS=0 and BB=0.
3. OS polls BOHC: when BOS=0 and BB=0, OS owns the HBA and may proceed.
4. If SMI on OOC is enabled (SOOE=1), BIOS gets an SMI when OOS transitions 0→1.
